arguments.rationale:
The `priceOf` method takes three primitive parameters that represent a single concept: a Drink. Grouping them into a `Drink` object reduces primitive obsession and makes the signature clearer. 

Furthermore, it provides a natural home for the pricing logic. By moving the calculation into the `Drink` itself, we follow the "Tell, don't ask" principle, telling the drink to price itself rather than asking for its parts to calculate the price externally.

steps.title: Update DrinkPricer specs to use price(Drink)

<?php

use Brew\Drink;

describe(Drink::class, function () {
    it('exposes its properties', function () {
        $drink = new Drink('small', 'oat', 2);
        
        expect($drink->size)->toBe('small');
        expect($drink->milk)->toBe('oat');
        expect($drink->shots)->toBe(2);
    });
});

<?php

namespace Brew;

final class Drink
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $size,
        public readonly string $milk,
        public readonly int $shots,
    ) {
    }
}

<?php

namespace Brew;

use InvalidArgumentException;

final class DrinkPricer
{
    public function price(Drink $drink): Money
    {
        return $this->priceOf($drink->size, $drink->milk, $drink->shots);
    }

    public function priceOf(string $size, string $milk, int $shots): Money
    {
        $pence = match ($size) {
            'small' => 250,
            'medium' => 300,
            'large' => 350,
            default => throw new InvalidArgumentException(sprintf('Unknown size "%s".', $size)),
        };

        if ($milk === 'oat') {
            $pence += 40;
        } elseif ($milk === 'almond') {
            $pence += 50;
        } elseif ($milk === 'soy') {
            $pence += 30;
        }

        if ($shots > 1) {
            $pence += ($shots - 1) * 60;
        }

        return new Money($pence);
    }
}

<?php

use Brew\Drink;
use Brew\DrinkPricer;
use Brew\Money;

describe(DrinkPricer::class, function () {
    let('pricer', fn () => new DrinkPricer());

    it('prices a drink by its size', function () {
        expect($this->pricer->price(new Drink('small', 'dairy', 1)))->toBeLike(new Money(250));
        expect($this->pricer->price(new Drink('large', 'dairy', 1)))->toBeLike(new Money(350));
    });

    it('charges for plant milk', function () {
        expect($this->pricer->price(new Drink('medium', 'oat', 1)))->toBeLike(new Money(340));
        expect($this->pricer->price(new Drink('medium', 'almond', 1)))->toBeLike(new Money(350));
        expect($this->pricer->price(new Drink('medium', 'soy', 1)))->toBeLike(new Money(330));
    });

    it('charges for every shot after the first', function () {
        expect($this->pricer->price(new Drink('small', 'dairy', 3)))->toBeLike(new Money(370));
    });

    it('refuses a size it does not sell', function () {
        expect(fn () => $this->pricer->price(new Drink('huge', 'dairy', 1)))->toThrow(new InvalidArgumentException('Unknown size "huge".'));
    });
});
